body:
Regarding [1.8.1](https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/5.0/en/0x10-V1-Architecture.md#v18-data-protection-and-privacy-architecture), what would be acceptable identification and classification in regards to data protection? 
There is not a lot of material to go on. Getting the identification and classification wrong may likely lead to applying the wrong data protection, but I can't find a lot of good information on the subject. 
Do anyone have any good references that could be used to help regarding the implementation and testing here?

comments.body: Seems like this is WIP at NIST: https://www.nccoe.nist.gov/data-classification

| # | Description | L1 | L2 | L3 | CWE |
| :---: | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **1.8.1** | [MODIFIED, MERGED FROM 8.3.4, LEVEL L2 > L1] Verify that all sensitive data created and processed by the application has been identified and classified into protection levels, and ensure that a policy is in place on how to deal with sensitive data. | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | 213 |


The goal for 1.8.1 is to have filled pre-conditions for testing requirement which contain sensitive data like requirements in category 6.1, 8.*.*

So results of 1.8.1 must answer all the questions what have for testing mentioned requirements.

How exactly it must be classified or structured - for me personally, it's out of ASVS scope. Mentioned NIST project is good material to link in references.
That makes sense. The connection between 1.8.1 and 6.1 wasn't immediately clear to me, but that clarifies things to a certain extent.

title: 1.8.1 acceptable identification and classification in regards to data protection
